newsitem.title: USA: Electronic Hair sees 1996 below views.
newsitem.headline: Electronic Hair sees 1996 below views.

text.p: Electronic Hair Styling Inc said on Friday that it expects to be "marginally profitable" in 1996, but that it anticipates sales and earnings to be below analyst's expectations for the year.
According to First Call, the company's earnings for 1996 are estimated to be $0.25 a share.
Electronic Hair held an initial public offering of its stock in May 1996.
The comany cited extensive turnaround efforts at its Lamaur division for the shortfall.
It said that with the introduction of new products and extensive turnaround initiatives implemented during the year, growth in revenue and increased earnings are anticipated in 1997.
Electronic Hair said that prior to its acquisition of Lamaur in November of 1995 from Dow Chemical, Lamaur posted nine consecutive years of loss.
Electronic Hair Styling, Inc. is a company specializing in the manufacturing and sale of hair and personal care products.
